Dear [Mr Bullock](../persons.html#221),
I am glad you have succeeded at last in getting an opportunity for publishing[^1]
Certainly executors are very troublesome to deal with as they are not acting for themselves. I am sending an order paper for one person, a cousin, who I hope may have one

Yours truly

C M Yonge

[^1]: CMY refers to Bullock\'s Daily Lections project, to which she was contributing.
